# RAW CLIP — Macro conditionals (immutable, do not edit)

- Fetch date: 2026-11-25 (HTTP 200).
- Sources:
  - https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Macro_conditionals
  - https://wowpedia.fandom.com/wiki/Secure_command_options (currency caveat: carries banner "The API is no longer being updated here until further notice")
- Scope claim: conditionals are keywords used with macro commands, the RestrictedEnvironment, and SecureStateDriver API "to allow limited logic for player convenience without trivializing the game." Secure options let "a limited range of information, expressed using macro conditionals, be used to automate decision making."
- Allowlist is CLOSED: only listed keywords exist. Anything not listed (cooldown, aura, health, mana/resource, rotation) is untestable.
- Temporary targeting (not boolean; one-action target, does not change player target): `@unitId` (page names `@player`, `@target`, `@focus`, `@mouseover`, "etc." — full list on linked UnitId page); `@cursor` = ground under cursor (added Patch 7.1.0, 2016-10-25); `@none` = interrupts auto self-cast, forces targeting cursor; `target=` alias for `@`.
- Target-token verification vs requested list: `@player` CONFIRMED; `@focus` CONFIRMED; `@mouseover` CONFIRMED; `@target` CONFIRMED; `@cursor` CONFIRMED (7.1.0+). `@pet`, `@party1-4`, `@raid`, `@arena1-3` NOT NAMED on either page — UNVERIFIED (presumed covered by UnitId page, out of scope).
- Boolean conditionals, target-evaluated (default @target): `exists` (~UnitExists); `help` / `harm` (~UnitCanAssist/UnitCanAttack); `dead` (~UnitIsDeadOrGhost); `party` / `raid` (~UnitInParty/UnitInRaid; party EXCLUDES self); `unithasvehicleui` (~UnitInVehicle). `no` prefix reverses.
- Boolean conditionals, player-evaluated (always @player): `advflyable` (~IsAdvancedFlyableArea; added 10.0.7, 2023-03-21); `canexitvehicle`; `channeling` / `channeling:spellName` (~UnitChannelInfo("player")); `combat` (~InCombatLockdown/UnitAffectingCombat("player")); `equipped:type` / `worn:type` (types per ItemType, e.g. weapon/sword; ~IsEquippedItemType); `flyable` (UNRELIABLE in Wintergrasp per page); `flying` (~IsFlying); `form:n` / `stance:n` (per GetShapeshiftForm; exact n NOT on these pages); `group` / `group:party` / `group:raid` (~IsInGroup/IsInRaid); `indoors` / `outdoors` (~IsIndoors/IsOutdoors); `known:name` / `known:spellID` (~GetSpellInfo/IsPlayerSpell; also works with #showtooltip; added 10.0.2, 2022-11-15); `mounted` (~IsMounted); `pet:name` / `pet:family` (per UnitCreatureFamily("pet")); `petbattle` (~C_PetBattles.IsInBattle); `pvpcombat` (PvP talents usable; added 7.3.0, 2017-08-29); `resting` (~IsResting); `spec:n` / `spec:n1/n2` (~GetSpecialization); `stealth` (~IsStealthed); `swimming` (~IsSubmerged).
- Boolean conditionals, UI-evaluated: `actionbar:n` / `bar:n` / `bar:n1/n2/...` (~GetActionBarPage); `bonusbar` / `bonusbar:n`; `button:n` / `btn:n1/n2/...` / `btn:<virtual click>` (1 left, 2 right, 3 middle, 4/5+ extra, or virtual click name; ~OnClick); `cursor` (dragging an action button; ~GetCursorInfo; distinct from `@cursor`); `extrabar`; `modifier` / `mod` / `mod:key` / `mod:action` (shift, ctrl, alt, lshift, rshift, ... or any IsModifiedClick action title); `overridebar`; `possessbar`; `shapeshift` (temp shapeshift bar); `vehicleui`.
- REMOVED: `talent` (added 6.0.2, 2014-10-14; REMOVED 10.0.0, 2022-10-25). Shorthand alternatives added 2.3.0 (2007-11-13); page added 2.0.1 (2006-12-05).
- Confirmed negatives (exhaustive absence from closed allowlist): no conditional tests spell cooldown; aura presence; health; mana or any resource; rotation priority. Closest non-qualifying readings: `dead` (binary only); `help`/`harm` (targetability only); `channeling` (player cast state only); `equipped`/`known`/`spec`/`form` (static loadout state).
- Flags: `cursor` vs `@cursor` (different slot/meaning); `party` (target) vs `group:party` (player); `pet:name` vs `petbattle` (unrelated); `flyable` unreliable in Wintergrasp; form/stance n, equipped types, mod action titles, spec numbers, virtual-click names on LINKED pages, not these two; no contradictions between the two pages on shared syntax.
- Unresolved: `@pet`/`@party1-4`/`@raid`/`@arena1-3` target tokens; exact allowed values for form:n, equipped subtypes, spec numbers, action titles, virtual click names; post-10.0.7 currency (API-stale banner).
